description: This file contains shell script functions for platform-specific upgrade procedures, including image validation, partition handling, copying EFI system partition files, and performing the upgrade process on a specific hardware platform.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the uploaded image matches the device's partition layout

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to a partition

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_efi_system_partition
methods.description: Updates the EFI system partition with new EFI boot files

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade function that handles partition table updates, image flashing, and system configuration adjustments
